extracted.intended_audience: airlines, aircraft manufacturers, pilots, aviation safety and regulatory professionals, legal counsels, and other stakeholders interested in FAA proposed rules
extracted.subtask_description: An API-style listing of Federal Aviation Administration Proposed Rule documents published in the Federal Register, each with title, abstract/excerpt, document number, links, and publication date. Covers proposed airspace actions, airworthiness directives, and regulatory proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish RNAV Route Q-855 and revoke Jet Route J-549
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to establish Canadian Area Navigation (RNAV) Route Q-855 and revoke Jet Route J-549 in the vicinity of Williston, North Dakota.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAA is proposing these actions to provide enroute continuity with NAV Canada's ongoing route structure modernization efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish RNAV Route Q-838 and revoke Jet Route J-539
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to establish Canadian Area Navigation (RNAV) Route Q-838 and revoke Jet Route J-539 in the vicinity of Glasgow, MT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAA is proposing these actions to provide enroute continuity with NAV Canada's ongoing route structure modernization efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Hélicoptères Guimbal (Model Cabri G2): revise rotorcraft flight manual
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed airworthiness directive for certain Hélicoptères Guimbal (HG) Model Cabri G2 helicopters prompted by potential ELT malfunction and weak ELT signals due to improper antenna installation (location).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This proposed AD would require revising the existing rotorcraft flight manual (RFM) for the helicopter to address the unsafe condition on these products.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Airbus SAS A330-841/A330-941: lavatory floor fittings inspections and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain Airbus SAS Model A330-841 and A330-941 airplanes prompted by reports of corrosion on lavatory floor fittings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This proposed AD would require repetitive inspections of the affected lavatory floor fittings and applicable corrective actions; would allow replacement of each affected floor fitting as an optional terminating action; would limit installation of affected parts under certain conditions and prohibit installation of an affected lavatory for certain airplanes.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Airbus Helicopters EC155B/EC155B1: revise airworthiness limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD prompted by determination that new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations are necessary for Airbus Helicopters Model EC 155B and EC155B1 helicopters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This proposed AD would require revising the airworthiness limitations section (ALS) of the existing maintenance manual (MM) or instructions for continued airworthiness and the existing approved maintenance or inspection program, as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend Class D and Class E airspace over New Bedford, MA
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to amend Class D and Class E airspace over New Bedford, MA by adding an extension to contain current IFR operations and update airport name and geographic coordinates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also proposes to replace 'Airport/Facility Directory' with 'Chart Supplement' in the Class D airspace legal description to comply with current FAA guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation: Restrict operation of unmanned aircraft near fixed site facilities (UAFR process)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to implement section 2209 of the FAA Extension, Safety and Security Act of 2016 by establishing a process for operators/proprietors of certain fixed site facilities to request and maintain an unmanned aircraft flight restriction (UAFR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposal establishes requirements for applicants to demonstrate the UAFR is necessary for aviation safety, protection of people/property on the ground, national security, or homeland security, and identifies the types of operations allowed in the UAFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersede AD 2023-21-10 for ATR airplanes: expand applicability and inspection areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed to supersede AD 2023-21-10 for certain ATR Model ATR42-500 and ATR72-212A airplanes which required inspection of horizontal stabilizer (HS) components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since issuance of AD 2023-21-10, additional airplanes and additional areas must be inspected; this proposed AD would continue prior actions and require inspecting the HS front spar web and center box internal area for discrepancies and applicable corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Airbus A320/A321 family: rototest inspection for bulk cargo door cracks
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain Airbus SAS Model A320/A321 variants prompted by a fatigue test that identified cracks in forward and aft upper corner of the bulk cargo door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This proposed AD would require a rototest inspection for cracks and applicable on-condition actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — GE CF34 engines: restart tests, borescope inspections, and functional checks
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain General Electric Company Model CF34 engines prompted by a dual engine power loss event and findings of corrosion in the high-pressure compressor (HPC) case affecting the variable geometry (VG) system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require performing certain restart tests and, depending on results, additional actions; borescope inspection of HPC case for corrosion and possible VG system functional checks, force gage tests on feedback cable, visual inspection for obstruction, possible engine removal from service; would require revising the ALS of the engine maintenance manual to incorporate the VG system functional check.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Boeing Model 757: inspect reinforcing repairs in fuselage frame lower lobe
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for all Boeing Model 757 airplanes prompted by reports of crack damage at existing reinforcing repairs in fuselage frame lower lobe areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require inspection for any existing reinforcing repairs in specified fuselage frame lower lobe areas and applicable on-condition actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of Prohibited Area P-75 (New York, NY)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to establish Prohibited Area 75 (P-75) in the vicinity of the New York, NY, residence of the President of the United States to restrict aircraft operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requested by US Secret Service to provide safeguards for securing non-Governmental property and protect USSS protectees in the interest of national security.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Bombardier BD-700-2A12: general visual inspection of slat 2 cove rib 6 fasteners
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain Bombardier Model BD-700-2A12 airplanes prompted by reports of missing or under torqued fasteners on the slat 2 cove rib 6 brackets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require a general visual inspection (GVI) of affected fasteners on slat 2 cove rib 6 brackets to determine if all fasteners are installed and applicable on-condition actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend Class D and remove Class E4 airspace over Nashua, NH
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to amend Class D airspace and remove Class E4 airspace (surface-based) for Boire Field Airport, Nashua, NH because it is no longer needed to contain IFR operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also proposes to replace 'Notice to Air Missions' within the Class D legal description with 'Notice to Airmen' to comply with current FAA guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Textron Model 408: revise Airworthiness Limitations Section and maintenance program
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain Textron Aviation, Inc., Model 408 airplanes prompted by manufacturer's revision of AMM to add detailed inspection for horizontal stabilizer spar and change serial effectivity for vertical stabilizer spar inspection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require revising the Airworthiness Limitations Section (ALS) of the existing AMM or instructions for continued airworthiness (ICA) and the existing approved maintenance or inspection program, as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersede AD 2025-16-12 — Airbus NEO family: repetitive replacement of HPV clips
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed to supersede AD 2025-16-12 which required revising AFM and MEL and allowed replacement of affected high-pressure bleed valves (HPV) as optional terminating action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAA determined repetitive replacement of the HPV clips is necessary; this proposed AD would continue previous actions and require repetitive replacement of each affected HPV clip and prohibit installation of affected parts as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Leonardo AW189: repetitive inspections of ejector ducts
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for all Leonardo Model AW189 helicopters prompted by reports of cracking on the ejector ducts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require repetitively inspecting LH and RH ejector ducts, including exhaust bracket reinforcements and reinforcement plates, and, depending on results, replacing any affected ejector duct.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Airbus A330 (with certain STC): revise AFM-S to limit ETOPS-180 crew and correct oxygen info
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for certain Airbus A330-200 and A330-300 airplanes modified by a certain STC where a single oxygen cylinder supply for flightcrew oxygen may be insufficient for ETOPS-180 with four crew.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require revising the existing Airplane Flight Manual Supplement (AFM-S) to limit ETOPS-180 operations to three flightcrew members, as applicable, and correct minimum oxygen dispatch pressure information.

rubrics_metrics.name: AD — Boeing 737-600/-700/-800/-900 series: inspect aft drain mast area and fuselage skin
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed AD for Boeing 737 variants prompted by reports of fuselage skin cracks found near the aft drain mast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would require inspection of aft drain mast area and surrounding fuselage skin for any repair, repetitive inspections of the fuselage skin and structure common to the aft drain mast for any crack and any corrosion, and applicable on-condition actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersede AD 2021-02-13 — Boeing 737 variants: extend inspection area and applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed to supersede AD 2021-02-13 which required inspections of fuselage skin and bear strap at forward galley door for cracks and on-condition actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A report of cracking outside required inspection area and determination that additional airplanes may be subject prompted this proposed AD to continue previous actions, add airplanes to applicability, and add inspections for an extended inspection area.
